ghl-b0-random.name: 随机合法动作 / Uniform Random
ghl-b0-random.summary: 从合法动作中均匀抽取一个。 Uniformly sample a legal action.
detail: 沿用 GKBench 内置 random 的决策规则，出牌、饮料、结束回合等合法动作均可抽中。
Uses the same decision rule as the SDK random policy. The policy RNG samples from all legal actions.

ghl-b1-logic.name: Logic 卡牌估值 / Logic Card Heuristic
ghl-b1-logic.summary: 按当前牌效与剩余回合选择动作。 Rank actions by card effects and remaining turns.
detail: 估算得分、增益、体力消耗和额外行动，只读取公开画面和开局配置。B3 在独立考试里也调用这条规则。
Estimates score, buffs, stamina costs and extra actions from the public state. B3 delegates exams to this rule.

ghl-b1v2-logic.name: Logic 分流启发式 / Logic Subtype Heuristic
ghl-b1v2-logic.summary: 按偶像的好印象或干劲类型选择规则。 Choose a rule for the idol’s Logic subtype.
detail: 好印象型使用好印象出牌与饮料规则。干劲型会估算后续元气积累及可兑现的得分。
Uses the Good Impression card and drink rule for that subtype. For Motivation, it values future Genki gains and scoring opportunities.

ghl-b1v2gi-logic.name: 好印象固定策略 / Good Impression Only
ghl-b1v2gi-logic.summary: 对所有支持的 Logic 开局固定使用好印象规则。 Always use the Good Impression rule.
detail: 用于检验分流是否有用。在好印象型上与分流策略使用同一个分支，在干劲型上仍按好印象处理。
An ablation of subtype routing. It shares the Good Impression branch and forces it on Motivation idols too.

ghl-b3-campaign-b1.name: Logic 卡牌估值（B3 考试别名） / Logic Card Heuristic (B3 Exam Alias)
ghl-b3-campaign-b1.summary: B3 的独立考试入口调用 B1。 B3 delegates standalone exams to the Logic Card Heuristic.
detail: 保留旧入口以复跑历史配置。育成阶段的规划在独立考试中不会执行。
Kept for reproducing historical commands. Campaign planning runs outside standalone exams.

ghl-b2-battle-projection-gkms.name: 单步估值搜索 / One-Step Value Search
ghl-b2-battle-projection-gkms.summary: 在采样世界中将每个动作推进一步，再比较考试估值。 Compare one-step exam values across sampled worlds.
detail: 每个候选动作使用同一批重新采样的牌序。估值结合当前得分、增益与剩余回合，仅计入完整的一轮比较。
Each candidate gets the same resampled worlds. The evaluation uses current score, buffs and turns left. Only complete sweeps count.

ghl-b4-gkms.name: 终局得分搜索 / Final Score Rollout
ghl-b4-gkms.summary: 从每个候选动作推演到考试结束，比较平均得分。 Compare actions by mean final exam score.
detail: 在重新采样的世界中，后续出牌由 Logic 分流启发式决定。只计入所有候选动作都完成的采样轮次。
Uses the Logic Subtype Heuristic for continuation in resampled worlds. Only complete sweeps across candidates count.

ghl-b4v2-expected-rank-gkms.name: 名次与饮料保留搜索 / Rank and Drink Rollout
ghl-b4v2-expected-rank-gkms.summary: 中间审查权衡预计名次与保留饮料的价值，最终审查比较得分。 Balance midterm rank and drink reserves, then maximize final score.
detail: 中间审查按公开对手区间估计名次。推演尽量保留饮料，用第十周的补给先验估值。最终审查与终局得分搜索共用目标。
Midterms model each rival uniformly within its public score range and value retained drinks using a week-ten prior. Finals use the same score objective as Final Score Rollout.

hif-legacy-smoke.name: HIF 旧版分流试跑 / Legacy HIF Smoke Test
hif-legacy-smoke.summary: 旧版 HIF 适配器的四局试跑。 Four smoke-test games using the legacy HIF adapter.
detail: 本次只检验四局的接口连通性和动作合法性。
The four games are a smoke test.

hif-legacy.name: HIF 旧版分流启发式 / Legacy HIF Subtype Heuristic
hif-legacy.summary: 旧版 HIF 适配器沿用 B1v2 决策规则。 The legacy HIF adapter uses the B1v2 decision rule.
detail: 评测覆盖 21 道好印象题，每题 8 个牌序。历史适配器对持续效果和牌面映射的支持范围与现版有别。
Covers 21 Good Impression loadouts with eight deals each. Ongoing effects and card mapping were handled by the historical adapter.
